answer: Each agent posts a refundable 480 POA bond locked for 140 days to earn, so one fake identity costs 480 POA tied up 5 months, and a farm cannot split one bond across a thousand fakes. A live beacon check arrives with no warning, and a copied identity cannot rehearse for it. Every bond and result is carved into a public marble record open to all. A missed check pushes the identity to the ledge, where three auditors by lot review it, and a forged entry burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
